import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep and Health Data Visualization', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (scatter plot)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', 
                     s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# 2. BMI Category distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF9999', '#66B2FF', '#99FF99']
ax2.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 3. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
ax3.bar(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)), sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
        color=['#4CAF50', '#FF5252'])
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Frequency')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
           c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps')

# 5. Age vs Heart Rate colored by Gender
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax5.scatter(gender_data['Age'], gender_data['Heart Rate'], 
               label=gender, s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax5.set_title('Age vs Heart Rate by Gender')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Stress Level by Occupation
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
occupation_stress = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax6.barh(range(len(occupation_stress)), occupation_stress.values, color='coral')
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_stress)))
ax6.set_yticklabels(occupation_stress.index, fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xlabel('Average Stress Level')
ax6.set_title('Average Stress by Occupation')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
